preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for x in queries for c in x)
preconditions.description: All characters in s and all xi are lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(s) <= 10**6 and 1 <= n <= 10**5 and sum(len(x) for x in queries) <= 10**6
preconditions.description: s is non-empty with length ≤ 10^6, n is between 1 and 10^5, and total length of all xi is ≤ 10^6.

preconditions.expression: queries == [x.strip() for x in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] and n == int(stdin.splitlines()[1])
preconditions.description: The second line of stdin is n (number of queries), followed by n lines of xi strings.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == n for stdout in outputs) and all(stdout.splitlines()[i].isdigit() for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Output contains exactly n lines, each a non-negative integer representing the count of cyclical isomorphic substrings for each xi.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) == sum(1 for j in range(len(s)) if len(s) - j >= len(xi) and is_cyclical_isomorphic(s[j:j+len(xi)], xi)) for i, xi in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each xi, the output is the count of all consecutive substrings of s of length len(xi) that are cyclical isomorphic to xi. Two strings are cyclical isomorphic if one can be rotated to match the other.

postconditions.expression: is_cyclical_isomorphic(a, b) == (len(a) == len(b) and any(a == b[i:] + b[:i] for i in range(len(a))))
postconditions.description: Two strings a and b are cyclical isomorphic if they have the same length and one can be rotated to match the other (i.e., b is a rotation of a).
